title: Create tenant context system with AsyncLocalStorage and request middleware
acceptance_criteria: AsyncLocalStorage-based TenantContext class created in lib/tenant/context.ts
Middleware in app/middleware.ts resolves tenant from subdomain or path prefix
Middleware sets tenant context via TenantContext.run() for every request
getTenantId() utility returns current tenant_id or throws if unauthenticated/unresolved
Tenant resolution supports both subdomain (tenant.yourapp.com) and path-based (/tenant/slug/) strategies
Middleware respects public routes (/, /auth/*, /api/auth/*) without tenant requirement
completion_summary: Created lib/tenant/context.ts (AsyncLocalStorage TenantContext with run/get/getTenantId/requireTenantId/update). Created app/middleware.ts (resolves tenant from subdomain or path prefix via x-tenant-slug header). Created lib/tenant/resolve.ts (withTenant wrapper for API routes, slug-to-UUID resolution with cache).
